components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The screen's one filled action: amber fill, on-accent label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-2, 6px); background:var(--accent, #F5B649); color:var(--on-accent, #131518); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover, #FFC46A); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tonal action, e.g. Filters on Race browse.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-2, 6px); background:var(--bg-2, #272B30); color:var(--text-1, #F4F5F6); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--bg-3, #2C3035); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Tertiary Link Button
components.description: Text link action, e.g. Clear all filters in the chips row.
components.css: .ds-btn-tertiary { min-height:44px; padding:0 4px; border:0; background:none; color:var(--text-1, #F4F5F6); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:400; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:1px; text-underline-offset:4px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-tertiary:hover { color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); } .ds-btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Race browse search: surface fill, field-line boundary, magnifier icon.
components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; display:block; width:100%; } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; left:12px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); pointer-events:none; } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px 0 42px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-2, 6px); background:var(--bg-1, #1D2024); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--field-line, #686E75); color:var(--text-1, #F4F5F6); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:15px; -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); opacity:1; } .ds-search input:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:0; box-shadow:none; }

components.name: Format Chip
components.description: Neutral metadata chip, identical for every format; uppercase by CSS only.
components.css: .ds-format-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:var(--radius-1, 4px); background:var(--bg-2, #272B30); color:var(--chip-text, #BFC4CA); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.07em; line-height:1; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: A removable active filter: calm outline, never the accent.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-1, 4px); background:transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); color:var(--text-1, #F4F5F6); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.07em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-filter-chip svg { color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: List / Map Segmented Control
components.description: Raised track, pressed segment in bg-3 with a field-line outline. Native iOS: segments of equal width (gap G11).
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; padding:4px; border-radius:var(--radius-2, 6px); background:var(--bg-2, #272B30); } .ds-seg button { min-height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-1, 4px); background:transparent; color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { background:var(--bg-3, #2C3035); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--bg-3, #2C3035); color:var(--text-1, #F4F5F6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--field-line, #686E75); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Result Row
components.description: Signature: the finish time is the loudest thing on the row; proof stated, not stamped.
components.html: HYROX London1:18:42HYROX 6 Dec 2025Self-reported · via results.hyrox.com
components.css: .ds-result { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:12px 16px 16px; border-radius:var(--radius-2, 6px); background:var(--bg-1, #1D2024); color:var(--text-1, #F4F5F6); text-decoration:none; font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; } .ds-result:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--field-line, #686E75); } .ds-result:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-result-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; } .ds-result-name { font-size:17px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; } .ds-result-time { font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk", "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:32px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.03em; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-result-meta { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-size:14px; color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); } .ds-result-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:var(--radius-1, 4px); background:var(--bg-2, #272B30); color:var(--chip-text, #BFC4CA); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.07em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-result-proof { font-size:13px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); }

components.name: Tab Bar

components.css: .ds-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); height:64px; align-items:center; padding:4px 8px; background:var(--bg-bar, #0F1114); border-top:1px solid var(--line, #31363C); } .ds-tabs a { display:grid; justify-items:center; min-height:44px; align-content:center; color:var(--text-2, #A3A9B0); font-family:"Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--accent, #F5B649); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #F4F5F6); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
A graphite stand with one amber light on it. The ground is dark but never black, and it gets lighter in small, even steps from the tab bar up to the raised controls. Type and contrast carry the energy, not color: the screen title and the key numbers (finish time, date day) sit in a heavy display face, and everything else is a quiet text face in sentence case. The amber accent appears once or twice per screen, only where you can act or where you are.

The product is an iPhone-shaped app (390px wide) in Operate mode: athletes scan a calendar of races and pull up their own results as proof. So hierarchy beats decoration. On a race card the date and the place lead and the photo is a black-and-white band, not a poster. On a result row the finish time is the loudest thing. The proof line under it says where the result comes from ("Self-reported · via results.hyrox.com"). It never stamps the result as verified.

What the screens refuse: aggressive "energy" red, pure black with one hot accent, one heavy condensed face for everything, no radius at all, per-format colors, success-green on results, and the artifact pages' values (`#0b0c0e`, the `#ff4d2e` family).
keyCharacteristics: Dark with depth: five background levels between L* 4.99 and 19.67, all near-neutral (C* ≤ 3.87).
One scarce accent, sodium amber `#F5B649`: the primary action and the current tab, and nothing else.
Two faces: Schibsted Grotesk 800 for the title and key numbers, Hanken Grotesk 400/600 for everything else.
Small radii: 4px inside, 6px outside. The Filters sheet's corners follow the native iOS sheet (12px today; see Native iOS).
Flat surfaces. The one shadow belongs to the Filters sheet.
Neutral metadata: format chips, filter chips, map pins, the saved confirmation and every pressed state stay gray.
Black-and-white photos, 3:1, inset in the race card.
Solar bold icons, drawn as CSS masks in the color of their text.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: The amber appears at most twice on a screen: the current tab, plus the one primary action if the screen has one. Race browse at rest has only the tab. Every other active state stays neutral: the active filter chip is an outline, the pressed segment is `--bg-3`, a checked checkbox is `--text-1`, the focus ring is `--text-1`.

rules.name: The Stated, Not Stamped Rule
rules.body: No green, no check icon and no "verified" mark on any result or anywhere on Results list. The saved confirmation is `--bg-1` with a gray save glyph.

rules.name: The Depth of Dark Rule
rules.body: Every background level has L* between 4.5 and 20 and C* ≤ 6, and each level is at least 1.5 L* above the one below it. `#000` and `#0B0C0E` are out.

rules.name: The Three Shouts Rule
rules.body: The display face is used for the screen title, the finish time and the date day, and nowhere else. Race names, chips, buttons, tabs and meta are the text face.

rules.name: The Name Stays Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is `text-transform` only. The format name in the markup never changes.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: Only a sheet casts a shadow. Everything else is a tone step.

dos: **Do** keep the amber to the one primary button and the current tab: at most two uses per screen.
**Do** make the finish time the loudest thing on a result row, through Schibsted 800 at 32px in `--text-1`, not through color.
**Do** lead a race card with the date tile (day 30px over month and year 13px) beside the name, chip and place.
**Do** show every photo in black and white (`--photo-filter`), inset at 3:1 with a 4px radius.
**Do** state proof as its own 13px `--text-2` line with one link icon: "Self-reported · via \<domain\>".
**Do** step a secondary action up or down so the screen keeps exactly one filled button.
**Do** take every value from `ui/kit.css`. Pages and the kit's classes hold no raw values.
**Do** draw icons as Solar bold masks in the color of their text: 15px in meta, 18px in buttons and fields, 26px in the tab bar.
**Do** keep 44px targets, a 2px `--text-1` focus ring, and 0ms motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** put the amber on a finish time, a chip, a filter chip, a count, a link, a focus ring, an icon in content, a status, or the map.
**Don't** use green, a check icon or the word "verified" on a result or on Results list.
**Don't** give formats their own colors. Every format chip is the same neutral chip.
**Don't** use pure `#000`, `#0B0C0E`, the `#ff4d2e` family, `src/style.css` or the wireframe grays.
**Don't** use aggressive "energy" red. Errors are soft coral `#EE8B84`, on the icon only.
**Don't** set race names, chips, buttons or tabs in the display face, or use one heavy condensed face for everything.
**Don't** drop the radius to 0 or round into pills.
**Don't** give cards a shadow or a border at rest.
**Don't** use tabular figures on finish times: Schibsted spaces the colons wide ("24 : 36").
